description: Source code for obstack memory management routines used in GNU C Library, including functions for initializing, allocating chunks, freeing objects, and debugging obstack allocations.

methods.name: _obstack_begin
methods.description: Initializes an obstack with specified chunk size, alignment, and allocation functions.

methods.name: _obstack_begin_1
methods.description: Initializes an obstack with custom chunk and free functions, and an extra argument.

methods.name: _obstack_newchunk
methods.description: Allocates a new chunk for the obstack, copying existing objects.

methods.name: _obstack_allocated_p
methods.description: Checks if an object was allocated from the obstack (for debugging).

methods.name: obstack_free
methods.description: Frees objects in the obstack from a specified point.

methods.name: _obstack_memory_used
methods.description: Returns total memory used by the obstack.
